title: Chapter 2
content_en: Other Tales 2: Chu YuyanIt’s spring, and everything is dark. Perhaps that’s not because it’s nighttime, but because my heart is filled with darkness.I choose to remain in the dark. I don't want to open my eyes. I don’t want to feel the world around me. I want to live in my own world. I don’t want to awaken....I can still remember the first time I saw him in the Reliance Sect oh so long ago, but I don’t want to remember that! I don’t want to think about it.Spring is when things are supposed to come back to life. But now, spring is gone. It's getting hot. I can hear people talking, including my Master, the incarnation of a medicinal pill.... He...
